title: Block as an intersection of incident supports
statement: Let $n,d$ be natural numbers and choose six pairwise disjoint $d$-element blocks indexed by the six edges of the complete graph on four vertices. For any edge, its block is the intersection of the incident supports of its two endpoints, where each vertex's incident support is the union of the blocks indexed by edges incident to that vertex.
hypotheses_covered: The choice consists of six disjoint blocks of size $d$ indexed by the edges of the complete graph on four vertices
The edge index selects one of the six edges
